title: JanSport 39L Odyssey Backpack, Navy

comparisons.notes: JanSport Odyssey Backpack, Navy, new, free shipping (Google Shopping listing)

writeup: The JanSport Odyssey is a big 39-liter pack with three main compartments, a padded sleeve that fits a 15-inch laptop or a 3-liter hydration reservoir, AirCore shoulder straps, a sternum strap and a tuck-away hip belt. Woot has the navy version new for $34.99, while Urban Outfitters lists the same pack at $110. Stock is limited to a handful of units with a 3-per-customer limit.
